name: comandos
description: Local-first terminal mission control for Claude Code, OpenAI Codex CLI, Gemini CLI and OpenCode. Run AI coding agents in parallel tmux sessions, manage direct SSH connections, monitor usage and continue securely from phone via Tailscale. No ComandOS cloud, hosted database, telemetry or SSH proxy.
